title: Grateful Dead Live at Knickerbocker Arena on 1995-06-21
source: First Generation Tapes; Taper Heaton,Transfer By Keo; Nakamichi CM300/CP4 Shotguns>Sony D7 (patched); Transfer Sony D7>Master Dat>Nakamichi LX3> Tapes Maxell XLII 90's; Transfer With Nakamichi MR-1>Korg MR-1000 @ 1 Bit/5.6 MHz; Tracking/Sample Rate Conversion/Metadata Tagging; With AudioGate Software To 32 Bit Float/96 kHz; Dithered/Flacked With Korg Aqua To 16/44; SBE's Checked/Fixed With Trader's Little Helper

ai_review.summary: Crisp audience recording of the 1995‑06‑21 show highlighted by Jerry’s haunting vocals and an epic Morning Dew.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a vivid, vibrant sound that outshines other audience recordings of this night, with Jerry Garcia’s voice described as a clear, haunting quiver and his guitar suddenly crisp. Reviewers point to the soaring close‑out with Morning Dew, plus Loser and U.S. Blues, making this the go‑to version for the show despite limited commentary from one reviewer.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance with several standout songs and a notably clear audience recording; only two reviews (one detailed) give enough data for a solid but not high‑confidence rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Much crisper and more vibrant than other AUD tapes of 06/21/95; clear vocal and guitar presence with good overall balance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A solid set that builds to a powerful close, highlighted by an emotional Morning Dew and energetic Loser/U.S. Blues.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Voice described as a clear, haunting quiver; guitar noted as crisp and vibrant on this recording.
